_comment: ADock engine v1 parameters. Scoring parameters are the published Vina / Vinardo values; search parameters are first guesses (not tuned).

_sources.vina: Trott & Olson, J Comput Chem 2010 (10.1002/jcc.21334); weights as in AutoDock Vina 1.2 source (src/lib/scoring_function.h, everything.h); num_tors_div effective weight 0.05846 = 0.1*(1.923+1)/5
_sources.vinardo: Quiroga & Villarreal, PLoS ONE 2016 (10.1371/journal.pone.0155183); radii and weights as in AutoDock Vina 1.2 source
_sources.xs_types: X-Score atom types as used by Vina 1.2 (src/lib/atom_constants.h xs_vdw_radii / xs_vinardo_vdw_radii; read from the Uni-Dock copy of the Vina 1.2 source). NB the Vinardo paper lists N 1.75, F 1.545, Cl 2.045, Br 2.165, I 2.36; we follow the Vina 1.2 implementation.

_metal_elements_note: Vina maps Mg/Mn/Zn/Ca/Fe to Met_D; Cu/Co/Ni added here (assumption, not in Vina)
_bond_note: Vina assigns receptor bonds when r < 1.1 * (cov_i + cov_j) (model.cpp assign_bonds)

grid._ligand_types_only_note: v2: build grids only for the ligand's own XS types (+ C_H probe), as Vina does
grid._out_of_box_note: quadratic penalty k*dist^2 (kcal/mol/A^2) per heavy atom outside the box; Vina uses a linear slope

v2_fitted._note: scoring-fit agent: fitted scoring function (config/adock_fitted.json, src/adock/fit) on the v2_default search; exact-Vina polish disabled, final ranking by exact fitted energy (adock.fit.fdock.kernel_cfg); see reports/scoring_fit.md

v2_consensus._note: consensus agent (src/adock/consensus, reports/consensus.md): v2_fitted search, all chain end states kept, clustered at 2 A sym-RMSD, clusters ranked by fitted E_min - alpha*ln(n_chains) (funnel width); alpha chosen on val_plinder val_select holo from {0.25, 0.5, RT, 1.0}. val_confirm (run once): NOT better than v2_fitted (holo -2.4/-1.8 points seeds 0/1, AF +0.7/0.0) -> negative result, v2_fitted remains the recommended preset.

v2_consensus2._note: as v2_consensus but pooling two fitted runs (seed, seed+1000): about 2x the v2_fitted cost; val_select holo seeds 0/1: 77/67 vs v2_fitted 66/63; not run on val_confirm

v2_af_fitted._note: scoring-AF agent: joint holo+AF refit with gauss1 width 0.8 (config/adock_af_fitted.json) on the v2_default search; see reports/scoring_af.md

v2_rerank._note: rerank agent: v2_fitted search, then a conditional-logit re-ranker (<= 15 interpretable features, L2) over the top-K fitted cluster representatives (src/adock/rerank; model config/adock_rerank.json trained on fit pools only by scripts/rerank_train.py); NOT recommended: its val gain comes from the distance-to-box-centre feature (box built around the crystal ligand) and reverses (-5 points) with a 3 A box-centre offset; see reports/rerank.md

_v2_note: v2_* modes use the fused CUDA engine (src/adock/mckernel.py); first attempt at budgets, see reports/engine_v2.md. On CPU, or with a non-stock potential, dock_batch falls back to the v1 torch preset named in torch_fallback. 'fast'/'accurate' are the unchanged v1 torch presets (used by the scoring-fit scripts and CPU mode).
_search_note: fast = config A of the 2026-10-26 val sweeps (results/adock/val_*_A*.csv); stageA_atom_cap 0.3 chosen on val_astex (0.1: similar, 1.0: much worse); mc_temperature 1.2 = Vina's Metropolis temperature; cluster_rmsd 2.0 A as in task spec; everything else is a first guess
_prep_workers_note: process pool size for receptor/ligand preparation in dock_batch (AGENTS_BRIEF: <= 8 cores); 0 = serial
_box_key_note: records from scripts/prepare_records.py: primary = pocket cube (>=24 A), secondary = ligand autobox; dev records use pocket/autobox
